evidence: Walked all 54 graded criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraints gates, 42 Functional, 6 Polish, 3 Visual; counts re-derived with grep on the frozen judge.toml files) against the golden source and found none the reference cannot satisfy. Editor criteria: src/custom-editor.js implements grapheme stepping with Intl.Segmenter (previousGraphemeBoundary/nextGraphemeBoundary), preferred-column vertical movement (moveCaret), double/triple click and drag (onMouseDown, event.detail), native copy/cut/paste events, Alt and Ctrl/Meta click carets with offset-based multi-caret insert ('Work on document offsets so carets sharing a line keep their own text'), deleteAcrossCarets, grouped typing undo that snapshots the caret (pushGroupedUndo/snapshot/restore), Ctrl+Home/End, revealCaret on both axes, block indent that skips a line whose selection ends at column 0 ('const last = range.end.line - (range.end.col === 0 ? 1 : 0)'), literal indexOf find with wrap, replaceCurrent advancing past inserted text, split/join Replace all, acorn-based token classes with six distinct colours in style.css lines 25-31 (keyword #c792ea, function #82aaff, string #c3e88d, number #f7ae72, comment #8296aa, default #d8e5f3; tag #f07178, attribute #ffcb6b), and prettier formatting with 'Already formatted.' and 'Format failed, draft unchanged'. Runtime criteria: src/runtime.ts runs each Run in a new sandbox='allow-scripts' iframe on the sibling host with CSP "connect-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'" and no unsafe-eval, instruments loops and functions with a 4.9 s guard plus a 5.1 s parent watchdog, maps thrown and rejected errors to one-based lines (sourceLine, rejectionLines, '\n'.repeat(script.line) for HTML), keeps console entries across runs, refuses ImportExpression statically and eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker via CSP with a visible reason, snapshots input values and canvas pixels for the last-good picture, and restarts the budget on trusted interaction. Persistence criteria: server.js uses SQLite at DB_PATH, 409 REVISION_CONFLICT on a stale revision, restore_operations keyed by operationId for idempotent replay, and app.tsx polls the library every 2 s without touching the editor, shows the conflict and newer-revision notices and a 'Retry same restore' control. Polish: ':focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}', footer text 'Escape, then Tab Leave editor', Undo/Redo disabled from state.undo/redo length, draft state label, focus returned after Format/Undo/Redo/Replace/Save. Measured on these exact bytes: frozen task equals projects/colderwater-playground-devtools (diff -rq clean), and the scripted results show true for every one of the 3 gate, 42 Functional and 6 Polish ids with pageErrors [] (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, persist-before.json, persist-after.json; restart.json shows record 3 at revision 2 with history [2,1] after a real process restart). Supporting, not on these bytes: the hosted configured-judge run on the earlier candidate scored functional 1.0 (41/41), polish 1.0, visual 0.9167, reward 0.9833; diffing that run's artifacts/app/src against the frozen golden shows only four differences (one editor.focus() line in app.tsx save, toolbar markup split into two tool-row divs, script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline' added to the preview CSP, and CSS), server.js and runner.html identical. Risk stays true because: (a) no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so the reworded criteria, the new cw_basic_run_output and the Visual ratings after the layout CSS change are unmeasured by the real judge, and no Oracle score may be claimed; (b) latent golden defects that no criterion requires but a judge-chosen fixture could hit: runtime.ts line 366 passes user source through String.replace('</body>', prepared + ...) as a replacement string, so a draft containing $' , $& , $` or $$ is corrupted before it runs (reproduced in node: console.log('Cost: $' + 5) becomes console.log('Cost: </html> + 5)); custom-editor.js wordRangeAt treats '-' as a word character, so double-clicking 'one' in 'line-one' selects 'line-one', which a judge using hyphenated markers in cw_mouse_selection could read as selecting more than the word; and app.tsx Value renders logged objects, arrays and Error values as a collapsed <details> ('Object' / 'Array(n)'), so a marker logged inside an object is not visible until expanded. The 390 px screenshot shows an empty preview, but polish.cjs line 125 asserts the preview body text 'narrow ok' before the screenshot, so that is a full-page capture artefact of the cross-origin frame, not a golden failure.
suggested_fix: Not blocking for this row. Hardening worth doing in a later candidate: use a function replacement in runtime.ts buildRun (replace('</body>', () => prepared + ...)) so '$' sequences in user source are literal; drop '-' from the word class in wordRangeAt; render logged objects expanded or as inline text. Obtain a configured judge run on the final bytes before claiming any Oracle score.
